superseded_reviews.anatomy_basis: Krishna and human figures use ordinary two-arm, two-leg anatomy; visible cattle and calves are separate quadrupeds. The stanza has no multi-limbed deity depiction.

limbs_hands_feet.observations: The enlarged feet show five toes on each foot; both arms remain attached in the relaxed standing pose.

attachment_proportions.observations: Krishna’s weight-bearing stance and the two visible arms remain connected.

faces.observations: One youthful Krishna face is legible beneath the feather band.

duplication_fusion.observations: Two swans remain separate from one another and from Krishna; no second Krishna appears.

text_artifacts.observations: No lettering or watermark is visible on the river or frame.

scene_style_continuity.observations: The Yamuna, swans and lotuses match photo 007; the pale forehead mark about 4×15 pixels violates the shared plain-forehead contract.
